newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble o/n rates fluctuate on 1996 - end squaring.
newsitem.headline: Rouble o/n rates fluctuate on 1996 - end squaring.

text.p: Rouble overnight credit rates eased after an earlier rise caused by expectations of higher demand on year-end book-closing, dealers said on Monday.
roubles/dollar Dec 30 midday Dec 30 early Dec 27 close
Dealers said few banks were likely to trade on Monday and Tuesday ahead of the four-day Russian New Year holiday running from January 1 to January 4.

"It is important for banks to close books now... but this is not pushing up the rouble as huge funds were taken out of the Treasury bill market ahead of the year-end," ABN Amro Bank dealer Artur Lotov said.
